summary: Fresh full-branch backend and QA/system review at clean HEAD 9f4102e found two in-scope blockers: null/non-object Kafka payloads can escape poison-event DLQ handling and terminate the Knowledge consumer, and generated workspace-web fixture/report digests are stale after Workspace, Source, and Model OpenAPI changes. Focused backend tests passed; FastSystem passed 71 tests but failed its two compatibility gates.
validation: Backend reviewer inspected the complete origin/main...9f4102e candidate and re-evaluated both prior loop-4 blockers
Resolver, composition, and generation tests passed 30/30; lifecycle tests passed 25/25; Kafka tests passed 7/7
Knowledge Worker Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; validate-specs.py passed
QA reviewer traced REQ-001 through REQ-008 across the complete 64-path candidate diff
HTTP resolver tests passed 18/18; focused lifecycle/fence/deletion tests passed 4/4; focused Kafka tests passed 4/4
Model workload-generation tests passed 2/2 and Source workload-proof test passed 1/1
FastSystem ran 73 tests: 71 passed and two generated compatibility gates failed
Candidate remained clean at exact HEAD 9f4102ec5ce93111e876f0c4d2d9abd4bf5842f9
blockers: KnowledgeEventConsumer and DeadLetterRedactor do not safely classify Kafka null payloads or valid non-object JSON; ArgumentNullException/InvalidOperationException can bypass DLQ handling, terminate the worker, and leave REQ-004 unmet.

contracts/workspace-web/v1/fixture-manifest.json and the checked-in compatibility report retain stale hashes for changed Workspace, Source, and Model OpenAPI files, failing both FastSystem compatibility gates and REQ-008.
next_action: Return to code for null/non-object poison-event classification and regressions plus deterministic fixture/report regeneration, then rerun focused and FastSystem compatibility gates before another full review.

issues.title: Null and non-object Kafka payloads bypass poison-event handling
issues.details: Workers.cs ProcessEventAsync and DeadLetterRedactor assume non-null object JSON. Guard tombstones and non-object roots, keep redaction null/root-kind safe, and prove DLQ publication plus continued next-offset processing.

issues.details: Regenerate the workspace-web fixture manifest and compatibility report after Workspace, Source, and Model OpenAPI changes, then rerun both FastSystem compatibility gates and byte-for-byte generator checks.
